mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_legacy_matching_job ( research_no, include_keyword_text, exclude_keyword_text, use_auto_keywords, status ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, #{includeKeywordText}, #{excludeKeywordText}, 'N', #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_job SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_job SET status = 'COMPLETED', active_keyword_text = #{activeKeywordText}, candidate_pool_count = #{candidatePoolCount}, matched_count = #{matchedCount}, blacklisted_excluded_count = #{blacklistedExcludedCount}, fail_reason = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_job SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_legacy_matching_job WHERE research_no = #{researchNo} AND COALESCE(include_keyword_text, '') = COALESCE(#{includeKeywordText}, '') AND COALESCE(exclude_keyword_text, '') = COALESCE(#{excludeKeywordText}, '') AND COALESCE(use_auto_keywords, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
